beats.choice: Aren stays and listens to the garden he knows instead of running away from the quiet gray cloud above him.
beats.consequence: Aren hums the soft garden sounds he knows. The cloud trembles a little and lets one tiny, gentle drop fall near his feet.
beats.goal: Aren wants to find out why his familiar garden feels so quiet today.

beats.choice: Aren asks the cloud for its name. When the cloud does not know it, he kindly chooses not to make one up and just calls it Cloud.
beats.consequence: The cloud feels relieved and floats lower. It whispers that it has forgotten its song, and its name stays unknown for now.
beats.goal: Aren wants to understand the cloud's trouble and learn who it is.

beats.choice: Aren bravely walks from the garden he knows to the COMMONS, a place he has not seen before, and the cloud drifts along beside him.
beats.consequence: Aren listens closely and hears many soft sounds. He does not know who or what makes them, so he only says what he hears. The cloud's edges begin to glow a little.
beats.goal: Aren wants to look for sounds that might help the cloud remember its song.

beats.choice: Aren hums along with the cloud's wobbly first notes instead of correcting them, so the cloud feels safe to try.
beats.consequence: The cloud's wobbly notes make them both giggle. A small rhythm of soft drizzle follows, and the cloud remembers the first part of its song.
beats.goal: Aren wants to help the cloud try singing again.

beats.choice: Aren invites the cloud to sing in its own way. He chooses to wait for the cloud to remember its name instead of guessing one.
beats.consequence: The cloud sings its whole song and a gentle rain falls on the garden. Aren feels glad, and the cloud's name stays open until the cloud finds it.
beats.goal: Aren wants to bring the cloud's song back to the garden he knows.

spine.spine_summary: Aren, who knows his garden well, meets a quiet cloud that has forgotten how to sing. He is kind and does not invent a name for the cloud. Together they visit the unfamiliar COMMONS, listen, and hum gently. The cloud remembers its song and returns to sing it to the garden in a soft rain. Its name stays unknown until the cloud finds it.
